title: Quantitative analysis of PARP inhibitor toxicity by multidimensional fluorescence microscopy
protocol: Seed cells onto sterilized 12mm coverslips placed in 60-mm dishes.
Let cells attach and grow for 24 hours at 37°C in a humidified atmosphere with 5% CO2.
Transfer cells on coverslips to 24-well plates.
Subject cells to treatments as needed.
Incubate cells for 20 minutes in medium containing 10 μM EdU.
Fix cells with 3% formaldehyde in PBS for 12 minutes at room temperature.
Remove the formaldehyde solution and wash cells once with PBS.
Perform a pre-extraction on ice with 0.2% Triton X-100 for 2 minutes to remove soluble protein fractions (optional).
Permeabilize cells for 5 minutes at room temperature in 0.2% Triton X-100 in PBS.
Wash cells twice in PBS.
Wash fixed and permeabilized cells twice with PBS.
Incubate cells in blocking solution for 15 min at room temperature.
Dilute primary antibodies in blocking solution.
Invert coverslips over 35 μl of the desired primary antibody solution on parafilm.
Use a wet chamber to avoid evaporation during incubation.
Incubate with primary antibodies for 2 hours at room temperature.
Wash coverslips three times with PBS.
Dilute fluorophore-conjugated secondary antibodies in blocking solution.
Invert coverslips over 35 μl of the diluted secondary antibody solution on parafilm.
Incubate with secondary antibodies for 1 hour at room temperature protected from light.
Transfer the coverslips back to the 24 well dishes.
Wash the coverslips once with PBS.
Stain the DNA with a DAPI solution at 0.5 μg/ml in PBS for 10 minutes, protected from light.
Wash the coverslips three times with PBS after staining.
Briefly wash the coverslips with distilled water.
Place the coverslips on 3MM paper to dry.
Mount the coverslips using a Mowiol-based mounting medium.
For Mowiol preparation, mix 2.4 g of Mowiol with 6.9 g of 86-89% glycerol and add 6 ml distilled water while stirring.
Leave the mixture stirring for 2 hours at room temperature.
Add 12 ml of 0.2 M Tris (pH 8.5) to the mixture.
Incubate the mixture at 50-60 °C for 10 minutes to dissolve all components.
Repeat steps involving incubation until all components are dissolved.
Prepare aliquots of the prepared mounting medium and store them at -20°C.
Store mounted coverslips overnight at 4°C to allow complete Mowiol polymerization before image acquisition.
Acquire images in an unbiased fashion using the Olympus ScanR Screening System.
Equip the system with an inverted motorized Olympus IX83 microscope.
Include a motorized stage, IR-laser hardware autofocus, and a fast emission filter wheel with single band emission filters.
Attach a digital monochrome Hamamatsu ORCA-FLASH 4.0 V2 sCMOS camera \(2048 x 2048 pixel, 12 bit dynamics).
Acquire image information of at least 500 cells for the UPLSAPO 40x objective (NA 0.9) under non-saturating conditions.
Acquire image information of at least 2000 cells for the UPLSAPO 20x objective (NA 0.75).
Acquire image information of at least 5000 cells for each of the UPLSAPO 10x and UPLSAPO 4x objectives.
Choose the appropriate objective based on cell density, desired read-out, required image resolution, and camera field of view.
Use automated fluorescence microscopes or manually acquired images for quantitative image-based cytometry analyses.
Import extracted data into Spotfire data visualization software (TIBCO).
Generate color-coded scatter plots of asynchronous cell populations in a flow-cytometry-like fashion using Spotfire.
Quantify percentages and cell subpopulation averages within Spotfire.
Depict fluorescence intensities as arbitrary units.
Apply mild jittering to demerge overlapping data points for discrete data in scatter plots.
Compare similar cell numbers for different conditions within one experiment.
